dedupe_keys.name: solar data tools pv time series diagnostics

description: Solar Data Tools is a Python library for examining photovoltaic production time series when site metadata or weather measurements are limited. It detects data-quality problems and estimates loss factors from basic power output, supporting rooftop systems as well as utility-scale plants. Coverage and observation period follow the PV records supplied by an operator; no fixed solar fleet is bundled. The public source and documentation are available under custom BSD 2-Clause-style terms in the own LICENSE file, which includes institutional notices; GitHub classifies the licence as NOASSERTION. The diagnostics can help compare PV performance and choose reliability assumptions for electricity-system simulations. A caveat is that unlabeled data may not reveal the physical cause of every loss, and analysis of a sparse series requires careful interpretation. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS article, repository and licence were read without obtaining production data or running diagnostics.
